visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with brown hair styled in two high buns, wearing a white halter-style crop top and a short denim skirt, stands in an indoor restaurant. She is positioned on the left side of the frame, facing a man in a black t-shirt and dark pants. The setting features a warm, well-lit interior with grey concrete-patterned walls and wooden furniture. A service counter with a staff member is visible in the background, along with a decorative pendant lamp hanging above. (2) The woman extends her arm and points her index finger toward the man's chest area, then uses both hands to firmly grasp the bottom hem of his black t-shirt. She lifts the fabric upward, revealing his toned abdominal muscles to the camera. The man stands still, smiling with a mix of pride and slight embarrassment, while his left hand rests near his pocket, showing a large blue wristwatch on his wrist. (3) In a reciprocal gesture, the man reaches out and attempts to lift the bottom of the woman's white top. She immediately reacts by laughing and pulling back, using her hands to shield the hem of her shirt and prevent him from mirroring her previous action. Her facial expressions are vibrant and high-energy, squinting her eyes in laughter. The camera remains steady, capturing their playful physical interaction from a medium shot perspective. (4) The scene shifts slightly as the camera pans to capture a man sitting at a nearby table, wearing a brown long-sleeved shirt and a black baseball cap. He observes the interaction between the two main characters with a curious expression. In the deep background, the restaurant staff member continues their work behind the counter, which holds various items like a POS terminal and small figurines. The lighting remains consistent and natural throughout the sequence. (5) The woman continues her high-energy reaction, gesturing broadly with her hands while standing in the center of the frame. The man in the black t-shirt laughs and leans away slightly, maintaining the lighthearted tone of the interaction. On-screen text in traditional Chinese appears prominently at the bottom and center, providing commentary and variety-show style emphasis to the humorous events unfolding in the restaurant space.
